name: John Matthews
strengths: Matthews creates after the catch with suddenness and turns short throws into chunk YAC.
Matthews stacks cushions on trailing DBs with acceleration and does not gear down through contact.
Matthews finishes with physicality for a 5-10 / 188 frame and wins contested balls in traffic.
weaknesses: Matthews is not a jump-ball X — wins with suddenness and YAC more than pure contested size.
comparison: Matthews comps to Deebo Samuel — 5-10 / 5-11 frame band; suddenness + YAC/violence after the catch.
projection: Matthews projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at WR (packages Year 1). Ceiling: All-SEC playmaker — the explosive every-down WR who changes drives after the catch.
schemeFit: Matthews fits as a versatile perimeter / slot who can play all over the formation and win after the catch.
insiderNotes: Matthews is a compact, twitchy playmaker who creates after the catch. Acceleration stacks cushions, and he finishes with violence through contact. Wins with suddenness and YAC — a mover who stresses the defense all over the formation.
